record.key: Run the CPU method chosen under Detection method on the whole image and label what it finds, honouring the minimum area above. Everything the method reads is that category: the level's algorithm, the correction, the smoothing, which side is the object, filling holes, splitting a pair that touches and dropping what the frame cut. With Cellpose or a backend chosen this button falls back to Otsu, because those have the Object detection button of their own.
record.source: Run the CPU method chosen under Detection method on the whole image and label what it finds, honouring the minimum area above. Everything the method reads is that category: the level's algorithm, the correction, the smoothing, which side is the object, filling holes, splitting a pair that touches and dropping what the frame cut. With Cellpose or a backend chosen this button falls back to Otsu, because those have the Object detection button of their own.
record.translation: 在整幅图像上运行“检测方法”下所选的 CPU 方法，并标记其找到的内容，同时遵守上面的最小面积。该方法读取的所有内容都属于该类别：阈值水平的算法、校正、平滑、哪一侧为对象、填充孔洞、拆分相接触的一对对象，以及丢弃被边框截断的部分。若选择了 Cellpose 或某个后端，此按钮会退回使用 Otsu，因为它们有自己的“对象检测”按钮。

retired_records.key: 'bundled' is the historical packaged plaque model. It is kept so an old run can be reproduced; it misses about a third of the plaques on literature images. toxoplasma_plaque_v2 is the current model.
retired_records.source: 'bundled' is the historical packaged plaque model. It is kept so an old run can be reproduced; it misses about a third of the plaques on literature images. toxoplasma_plaque_v2 is the current model.
retired_records.translation: 'bundled' 是历史上随包提供的蚀斑模型。保留它是为了能够重现旧的运行；在文献图像上它会漏掉约三分之一的蚀斑。toxoplasma_plaque_v2 是当前模型。

records.key: Suits cells and nuclei of the kind Cellpose was trained on, and is the only method here that knows what an object looks like rather than only how bright it is. It is slow without a GPU.
records.source: Suits cells and nuclei of the kind Cellpose was trained on, and is the only method here that knows what an object looks like rather than only how bright it is. It is slow without a GPU.
records.translation: 适用于与 Cellpose 训练数据同类的细胞和细胞核，也是这里唯一知道对象外观、而不仅是亮度的方法。没有 GPU 时速度较慢。
